A '''gravmotor alternator''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] component. During a mission to [[Repair Station]] [[M13]], [[Green squad]] was asked to keep an eye out for gravmotor alternators to steal along with [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power packs]] and medical supplies.<ref name="Assault" />
